profile.name: Justin Gabriel Moreira Matarrita
profile.title: Information Systems Engineer
profile.tagline: Building software with intention, clean architecture, and steady focus.
profile.summary: Advanced Information Systems Engineering student, passionate about analyzing complex problems and building reliable, maintainable solutions. Proactive, collaborative, and quick to adapt to new environments and technologies.
profile.availability: Available for internships and junior roles

about.titleEnd: when ideas become systems that work.
paragraphs: I am an advanced Information Systems Engineering student in Costa Rica. My work sits at the intersection of clean architecture, practical problem-solving, and constant collaboration—whether modeling data in MySQL, building a Laravel backend, or composing a React interface.

Beyond coding, I enjoy teaching. I have facilitated robotics workshops for high school students and supported classmates in Robotic Process Automation courses with UiPath. Explaining complex ideas in simple, calm language makes me a better engineer.
I value craftsmanship, honest communication, and delivering work I would still be happy to maintain a year from now.

skills.title: Tools I rely on.
skills.description: A toolkit shaped by university coursework, mentoring, and real engineering projects. Always learning, always refining.

experience.title: Where I have learned, taught, and delivered results.

bullets: Leading development of an end-to-end management system for a veterinary clinic using Laravel.
Applied software engineering practices for requirements analysis, architectural design, and data modeling.
Coordinated team work with Scrum ceremonies and Kanban tracking.
Designed and facilitated educational robotics workshops for high school students.
Built robots and adapted teaching material to different learning levels.
Supported teams with practical problem-solving and continuous iteration.
Supported classmates in the Robotic Process Automation (UiPath) course.
Provided technical guidance during automation project development.
Reviewed code and process design to ensure stable and repeatable workflows.

items.title: Veterinary management system
items.subtitle: University capstone project
items.description: Comprehensive clinic platform: appointments, records, inventory, and billing. Built with Laravel and MySQL following a clean MVC architecture.
highlights: Relational schema design for patients, owners, and visits
Modular service layer to simplify testing

items.title: RPA automations with UiPath
items.subtitle: Process automation portfolio
items.description: Collection of automations that read structured data, validate it against business rules, and publish results to target systems. Used as mentoring support material.

items.title: REST API with Spring Boot
items.subtitle: Java backend course
items.description: RESTful service built with Spring Boot featuring CRUD endpoints, layered architecture (controller, service, repository), and validation.
highlights: Bean validation and global error handling

items.title: React components lab
items.subtitle: Frontend exploration
items.description: A small dashboard to explore component composition, hooks, and clean state management in React. It helped deepen my UI engineering practice.

education.title: Continuous study, deliberate practice.
education.description: University training is the foundation of my development: from algorithmic fundamentals to architecture and project management. Outside class, I keep building, mentoring, and learning.

items.notes: Programming fundamentals, software design, databases, and web development.
Advanced student. Focused on software architecture, data modeling, and project management.

contact.description: I'm open to internships, junior roles, and collaborative projects. The fastest way to reach me is by email or phone; I usually reply in under a day.
